label: Weaken founded coming-to-be to begun coming-to-be for premise A3 of the modal spine
summary: Finding 1: the proof of the possible contingent-free past (premise A3) from possible founded coming-to-be uses Acc only through minimalBelow, to reach a moment with nothing earlier. Asking for exactly that (BegunAt: some moment at or before the populated one has nothing earlier) gives the weak sibling premise A3′w, and BegunComingToBe.possibleContingentFreePast derives A3 from it with no frame condition, presence contract, inert emptiness, well-foundedness or causal relation. Finding 2, strength order: possiblyBegunOfFounded derives the weak version from the founded one, and Control.zeno (times WithBot Int, a first moment followed by moments with no earliest one) satisfies the weak version while no populated moment has a founded past, so the order is strict. Consequence: the founded version carries a price against continuous time with a first moment, since t, t/2, t/4 descend endlessly below any later t; the weak version carries none, and the second horn left to the initial-state view becomes a genuinely beginningless past rather than any non-well-founded past. Finding 3: in the same control every contingent individual has an existing predecessor, related to it by the control's grounding relation and present strictly earlier whenever it is present, yet no individual is necessary; inert emptiness (A2) fails there. So with begun pasts, earlier-present grounding of every contingent thing does not by itself carry even the possibility of a necessary concrete individual, unlike the founded-past bundle, which does; in the temporal arrival the necessary individual comes from inert emptiness. All three results pass Comparator and NanoDa locally. No premise is established; the weak premise is OPEN and is a possibility claim.
blocker: None for this derivation. Next tests: restate the earlier-grounds support route for A3′ (open PR #1463) over begun rather than founded pasts, which the control indicates no longer entails possible necessary being; and state the beginningless-past horn against causal-finitism and Grim Reaper premises formulated without the anti-continuum price of well-foundedness over moments.
